body:
Neocloud Together AI's latest funding round is a headline grabber. $800 million raised, pushing their valuation to $8.3 billion. Not just a big number—it's a sign of the growing trust in open-source AI models.

In the APAC region, hosting open-source models isn't just a technical service; it's becoming a crucial part of the AI infrastructure. Investors are betting big on companies that can provide reliable hosting solutions, and Neocloud is at the forefront.

Why does this matter? Hosting open-source models opens doors for faster, more adaptable AI solutions. It allows businesses to scale and innovate without the prohibitive costs of proprietary systems.

While market volatility is always a risk, the substantial backing from investors underscores a confidence in open-source's role in the future of AI. It's a trend to watch, especially for those interested in the intersection of AI infrastructure and open-source technology.
hooks: Neocloud Together AI just raised $800 million.
Open-source AI models are turning heads—and wallets.
cta: How do you see open-source AI shaping the future of tech infrastructure?
based_on: Neocloud Together AI raises $800M, leaps to $8.3B valuation
